programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max kisses Camila and begs her to run away together. They are surprised by Ezequiel who hatefully puts a gun to his son's forehead and hits him. Fausto gives Anton the last instructions to eliminate Ezequiel but Torrealba arrives. The wedding ends. A shot is heard.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Total chaos in the church after the shooting. Max is wounded. Ezequiel, takes her by the arm and leads her away, although he feels sorry for his son. Fausto and Roger are the protagonists of this thwarted murder. Ezequiel and Camila tell each other harsh truths.
